messages.subject: Docs published
messages.body: Updated README.md, docs/live-verification.md, and skills/orca-development/SKILL.md to record the failed live bridge trial honestly, distinguishing successful extension load/binding from unverified wakeup, inbox ack, and recovery. Checks passed with bun run check, bun test, and git diff --check, and the docs-only commit ea5c3366ab6ba254880733e1486075be266dd679 was pushed to origin/main after overriding a stale local gh credential-helper path for that push only. What remains is the documented next step: diagnose supported Pi launcher/input readiness and avoid double-binding before any newly approved short retry; no live retry or source/dependency change was made.
